reply.shortGloss: to look at; to watch; to check
reply.emotion: attentive and curious, turning toward something interesting
notes: Use mirar when you direct your eyes at someone or something. When you want to say 'to watch' a screen or a game, mirar is also the natural choice.

senses.definition: Dirigir los ojos hacia alguien o algo para verlos.

examples.text: Ella mira el mapa para encontrar la calle.
examples.translation: She looks at the map to find the street.
examples.emotion: focused and concentrated, trying to figure out the directions

senses.definition: Examinar o comprobar algo con atención.

examples.text: Voy a mirar el precio antes de comprarlo.
examples.translation: I am going to check the price before buying it.
examples.emotion: cautious and practical, being careful with money

definitions: Dirigir los ojos hacia alguien o algo para verlos.
Examinar o comprobar algo con atención.
